name: Euclidean Rhythms Grooves
author: Freek van Gool
description: Euclidean rhythm presets for Euclidean Rhythms by genre and culture: techno, house, Afro and Latin, dub and reggae, drum and bass and breakbeat, odd meters and polymeters, fills and rolls, and melodic note rows. Drum presets use one fixed lane plan: ch1 kick or low drum, ch2 snare, clap or mid drum, ch3 closed hat or shaker, ch4 open hat or high drum, ch5 to ch7 percussion (rim, clave, bell, cowbell, tom), ch8 crash or effect (rolls in the fill presets may borrow ch5 to ch7). Several rows may share a lane. Note presets send notes to one synth. Every row uses accents, ghost notes, contours, note length and humanize where it helps the groove.
